title: K-Concatenation Maximum Sum
goal: Find the maximum subarray sum in k concatenated copies, allowing an empty subarray.
strategy: At most two copies are needed to capture a boundary-crossing suffix and prefix. Additional complete middle copies help only if one copy has positive total.
